sheet_from: Data/Item/Estic.OZJ (32x64, pale green jade-like metal), Estic2.OZJ (32x32, green with a gold orb) and Estic2_R.OZJ (32x32, green veins on black), from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py; 268 triangles over three meshes.
material_overrides_note: As every built blade: steel's own 0.2 mirrors the scene.
glow_note: ItemObjectAttribute hides mesh 2, Estic2_R, from the body (HiddenMesh 2, ZzzObject.cpp:5278-5280), and RenderPartObjectBody draws it again added (BlendMesh 2) at sin(WorldTime*0.001)*0.5 + 0.3 of the light, its U sliding at WorldTime*0.001 and its V at -WorldTime*0.0005 (:7119-7128): green veins breathing slowly over the head. Here pulse [0.5, 0.3] at the slow rate and U sliding a sheet a second (scrolls_per_second -1, the renderer's offset being minus the rate); the V slide is left out, the renderer sliding one axis. MU's 0.3 - 0.5 dips below nought, so the veins go dark for a part of each breath, as here.
rig_note: Mace08.rig.json from export-rig --actions=all: two bones, one action of one key, nothing moves; kept for bone 1, where MuMain hangs a yellow BITMAP_LIGHT and a pulsing white one while it is held (ZzzCharacter.cpp:7568-7576; fx/held_lights).
material_note: Estic, the head's flanges, is steel at 0.45. Estic2, the shaft and the orb, is pale green paint: as steel it mirrored the grass and read black under the veins (studio, 2026-10-06), so painted_steel, as the Dark Phoenix's lacquer.
